claims.evidence: Raw file names encode orientation D4S8 / D8S4 and replicate _1.._3 (MaxQuant experiment names D4S8_1 ... D8S4_3; for A549 D4S8_1_I/_II/_III). Thesis 4.8: "either 100 uL of compound (DMSO-stock) or 100 uL DMSO as control were added to a pair of heavy and medium cells and vice versa for label-switch". One source per SILAC-labelled culture (one DMSO and one FM247 dish per mixture).

claims.value: D4S8 files: SILAC medium (Lys4/Arg6) = DMSO, SILAC heavy (Lys8/Arg10) = FM247; D8S4 files: SILAC heavy = DMSO, SILAC medium = FM247
claims.evidence: Explicit: thesis 4.2 / PRIDE protocol "medium = Lys-4, Arg-6; heavy = Lys-8, Arg-10"; "Arg6 and Lys4 as light and Arg10 and Lys8 as heavy isotope identifiers ... For raw files resulting from label switched experiments, the isotope identifiers were defined in reverse order resulting in the ratios of probe vs. DMSO." summary.txt: D4S8 files Labels0 Arg6;Lys4, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8; D8S4 files Labels0 Arg10;Lys8, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4 (Multiplicity 2 in all 30 SILAC files) -> MaxQuant H/L = probe/DMSO in every file, and the file names read D(MSO)<Lys label> S(ample=probe)<Lys label>. Data check: log2 H/L normalized of DJ-1/PARK7 (the paper's top target) is strongly positive in every quantified experiment of both orientations: HeLa D4S8 5.00/5.74/5.48, D8S4 5.98/5.62/5.84; SH-SY5Y D4S8 5.34/4.99/4.85, D8S4 4.79/4.22/4.27; A549 1.95-5.43 (D4S8_2 not quantified); other listed off-targets (HMOX2, P4HB, VDAC3, HMGCS1) also positive; GAPDH ~0. A wrong orientation would give negative ratios in one orientation. No conflict between sources.
Thesis 2.6: "After incubation with either 10 uM FM247 or DMSO as control"; 4.8: 100 uL compound DMSO stock or 100 uL DMSO in 10 mL PBS, 1 h, 37 C.

claims.value: 1-6 within each (cell line, compound) group: D4S8_1..3 -> 1..3, D8S4_1..3 -> 4..6
claims.evidence: Each SILAC mixture pairs one DMSO dish and one FM247 dish (thesis 4.8); three mixtures per orientation (_1.._3) give six independent cultures per (cell line, compound) group, numbered 1..6 (spec README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3).

limitations: The publication (ACS Chem Biol 2018, doi:10.1021/acschembio.8b00633) and its Supporting Information are closed access (no PMC copy, Unpaywall closed, ACS SI page 403, not bypassed). Methods and design come from the PRIDE protocol text, the author's open-access TUM dissertation (2020; same author, same experiments), the raw headers and the deposited MaxQuant outputs.
PRIDE/thesis prose list a variable "NH (aspartate)" modification; no deposited MaxQuant search contains it (summary.txt: Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term) only), so it is not annotated.

comment[cleavage agent details] appears twice (Trypsin, Lys-C). sdrf-tools build emits a single column for this non-multiple field, so the Lys-C column is inserted by the deterministic post-build script scripts/postbuild.py (campaign rules 2 and 17); justified in PXD009444.validation.txt.
Status REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL: no adversarial review was run by the producer (external hand-off).

A549 rounds: 18 A549 raw files for 6 SILAC mixtures (rounds I 20160527, II and III 20160616). They are encoded as technical replicates 1-3 of the same mixture because the authors' replicate index (_1.._3) is shared across rounds. The deposit does not say whether rounds II/III are re-injections or re-preparations from the same cultures; ratio correlations do not discriminate (a549_rounds.txt: same-mixture cross-round mean r 0.81 vs different-mixture 0.83). If they are independent cultures, biological replicate numbers 7-18 would be needed.

Thesis heading "Q Exactive Plus (HeLa)" conflicts with the HeLa SILAC raw files (Orbitrap Fusion); raw headers were followed. The thesis Table 4 also swaps the cell-type cells of HeLa and A549; Cellosaurus was followed.
SH-SY5Y characteristics[culture medium] = "DMEM/F12" has no NCIT term (validate-sdrf warning); SH-SY5Y developmental stage is "not available" (4Y donor; no verified EFO child-stage term).
characteristics[cell type] is "not available" for all rows: no source states a cell type (rule 9).
The HeLa D4S8_1 raw file carries the suffix "_2400V" (spray voltage); it is the only file for that mixture and is searched as experiment D4S8_1.
